name: MITF-M melanocyte pigmentation program with light response
rationale: All members concern MITF-M-driven melanocyte biology and melanin pigmentation; unlike the confusables it includes UV-A/blue-light responses, melanin biosynthesis and melanocyte differentiation rather than MITF-M cell-cycle and DNA-repair targets.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport in osmotic volume regulation
rationale: Members cover SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, renal salt handling and ion homeostasis; the theme is set apart by hyperosmotic, hypotonic, salt-stress and water-homeostasis responses absent from the confusables.

name: ER membrane protein biogenesis through COPII export
rationale: Members span SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion into the ER membrane and COPII cargo loading toward the Golgi; confusables instead carry ER folding, ERAD or COPI retrograde traffic, or lack the COPII arm.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling via SERCA reuptake
rationale: All members regulate calcium release from and return to the sarcoplasmic/endoplasmic reticulum; the theme uniquely includes regulation of ATPase-coupled calcium import into the SR, which confusables lack.

name: Erythroid differentiation with red cell membrane assembly
rationale: Members describe erythrocyte differentiation and its TAL1-GFI1B transcriptional control (one stress-signalling module is an outlier); late erythroid membrane/cytoskeleton modules distinguish it from megakaryocyte and stem-cell confusables.

name: Ornithine transcarbamylase step of the urea cycle
rationale: Members cover citrulline/arginine synthesis in the urea cycle and OTC deficiency variants; the OTC focus distinguishes it from confusables with other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ammonium homeostasis.

core: Antimicrobial defense against Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
name: Cytolytic antimicrobial defense against Gram-positive bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members describe host defense against bacteria and fungi via antimicrobial proteins, metal sequestration and cytolysis; regulation of killing and neutrophil cytotoxicity distinguish it from mucosal and respiratory-burst confusables.

name: Hexose assimilation into glycogen stores
rationale: Members span dietary carbohydrate digestion, hexose transport and glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases; confusables have either the transport arm or glycolysis/gluconeogenesis but not both absorption and glycogen storage.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling with RUNX3 tumour suppression
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling and its cancer mutants (glycoprotein hormones is an outlier); RUNX3-regulated targets and receptor/SMAD cancer mutants distinguish it from the confusables.

qualifier: in both B and T cells with co-receptor regulation
name: B and T cell antigen-receptor signaling with co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members are TCR/BCR proximal signaling with CD28 costimulation and BTLA, CTLA4, CD22 and PECAM1 co-inhibition; the BCR arm distinguishes it from T-cell confusables and PECAM1/co-inhibition from C1.

qualifier: centred on amino acids and peptides
name: SLC solute transport centred on amino acids and peptides
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC carriers and their transport disorders (amino acids, peptides, urate, organic anions); amino acid and peptide uptake distinguishes it from organic-cation and hexose confusables.

qualifier: by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
name: Vascular remodeling by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
rationale: Members regulate angiogenesis (VEGF, Tie2, sprouting) and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; combining both cell types distinguishes it from endothelium-only C4 and smooth-muscle or leukocyte-adhesion confusables.

name: Amino acid metabolism with tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid synthesis and catabolism terms (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, aromatic); tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism distinguishes it from threonine and organic-acid confusables.

name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors via Wnt-RUNX2 control
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor proliferation and differentiation; RUNX2 regulation, Wnt antagonism and PIEZO1 mechanosensing distinguish it from chondrocyte, collagen and osteoclast confusables.

name: B cell activation and homeostasis through BCR signaling
rationale: Members cover B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and BCR signaling (two leukocyte BTM modules are peripheral); BCR proximal signaling and its restraint distinguish it from plasma-cell, germinal-centre and T-cell confusables.

name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation underlying sensory behavior
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 function and its loss (Rett) in neuronal transcription with touch, proprioceptive and visual behavior; MECP2 members distinguish it from C2/C3, and absence of locomotor behaviors from C4.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle control
name: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle control, including termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II initiation, elongation and termination plus R-loop processing (one growth-factor BTM is an outlier); termination and R-loop terms distinguish it from elongation-focused and rRNA/splicing confusables.

name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release dampening cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate sarcoplasmic calcium release via ryanodine receptors and its removal by Na/Ca exchange; negative regulation of cardiac contraction and heart rate distinguishes it from SERCA-focused and positive-inotropy confusables.

name: p53-driven apoptosis via BH3-only PUMA and NOXA
rationale: All members are p53 transcriptional control of death genes and mitochondrial apoptosis; BH3-only PUMA/NOXA activation and cytochrome c release distinguish it from p53 signaling confusables, and p53 transcription from BAX/BAK confusables.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members follow oocyte maturation, follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis; corpus luteum and estrous-cycle terms distinguish it from gonadotropin-response confusables.

name: Neutral and acidic amino acid uptake across plasma membrane
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane amino acid carriers and their defects (SLC6A19, SLC6A14, SLC1A1, proton-coupled); the acidic SLC1A1 and broad SLC6A14 carriers distinguish it from iminoglycine/peptide confusables.

name: Centrosome-anchored microtubule organization for spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and anchoring at the MTOC; spindle orientation and asymmetric division distinguish it from centriole-duplication and cytokinesis confusables.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and constitutive secretion; recycling to the surface distinguishes it from Golgi-endosome-lysosome and Rab-GAP confusables.

name: Cardiac muscle adaptation including positive inotropy
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and regeneration; positive regulation of contraction force and heart rate distinguishes it from calcineurin-focused C4 and smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Golgi architecture remodeling including membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly and positioning; membrane tubulation and ribbon reorganization distinguish it from Golgi protein-localization and COPI confusables.

name: DNA base damage repair including direct alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair steps and glycosylase defects plus MGMT/ALKBH alkylation reversal; alkylation reversal and long-patch gap filling distinguish it from glycosylase-recognition and mismatch-repair confusables.

name: Rho GTPase cycles centred on RHOA-C and formins
rationale: All members are Rho-family GTPase cycles or effectors; RHOA/B/C, RHOD and formin activation distinguish it from RAC, RND, PAK and ROCK confusables.

name: Bilirubin clearance via hepatic organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, bilirubin conjugation (UGT1A1) and OATP/ABCC2 export with hyperbilirubinemias; bilirubin handling distinguishes it from drug-ADME confusables.

name: Proline and glycine transport defects causing iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, absent from all confusables.

name: Motor coordination via cerebellar and striatal development
rationale: Members cover motor learning, locomotion, righting and proprioception with cerebellar layer and striatum development (an RNA-binding BTM is an outlier); motor and striatal terms distinguish it from vocal/sensory and cerebellar-precursor confusables.
